insurer: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: Shared accommodation pays ₹500/day (max ₹2,000/hospitalisation, ₹10,000/policy period). Proportionate deduction applies if higher room chosen.

icu.note: ICU charges covered under general hospitalisation expenses (Section C); no separate daily cap stated. ICU stay not counted as shared accommodation.

copayment.note: Applies to all fresh and renewal policies; no exceptions stated.

sub_limits.display: Multiple sub-limits: AdenoTonsilectomy, Seizures, Fractures, Botox, Therapies, Modern Treatments
sub_limits.note: AdenoTonsilectomy ₹25k; Seizures ₹30k; Fractures 20% SI; Botox ₹20k; Behavioural/Physio/OT/Speech ₹1,500; Modern treatments individually capped (e.g. Robotic ₹75k, Deep Brain Stim ₹75k).

initial_waiting.note: Waived for accidents; waived if continuously covered for more than 12 months.

ped_waiting.note: Reducible via portability/migration credits; no optional add-on to reduce further mentioned.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Covers ENT, hernia, hydrocele, gallbladder, kidney calculi, benign lumps, joint diseases, eye conditions, fistula, haemorrhoids, etc. Waived for accidents.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Code Excl 18); ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording.

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

pre_hosp.note: Policy covers post-hospitalisation but no pre-hospitalisation benefit is mentioned.

post_hosp.note: 7% of hospitalisation expenses or actuals up to 60 days post-discharge, whichever is higher.

day_care.note: Day care procedures covered as per standard definition (technological advancement enabling <24hr treatment).

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH hospitalisation covered up to sum insured. Yoga/Naturopathy requires prior company approval; Naturopathy listed as specific exclusion (Code Excl 40).

organ_donor.note: No organ donor expense benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

ambulance.note: Emergency road ambulance; actuals subject to ₹750 per hospitalisation and ₹1,500 overall per policy period.

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments covered with individual caps per policy period (e.g. Robotic surgery ₹75k, Oral Chemo ₹37.5k, Bronchial Thermoplasty up to SI). Sum insured is ₹3L.

consumables.note: Many consumables are subsumed into room/procedure charges per the listed items, but no explicit consumables cover or rider is offered.

global_cover.note: Territorial limit clause restricts all treatment to India.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud. Enhanced SI moratorium runs from date of enhancement.

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual/other modes; 15 days for monthly premium payment mode.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: Cerebral palsy, mental retardation, genetic anomalies, bone marrow transplant, chondrocyte implant, erectile dysfunction, dental (non-accident), cochlear implants, naturopathy, circumcision

optional_riders.note: No optional riders or add-ons described in the policy wording.
